articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Enhanced Reasoning and 2M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic has unveiled Claude 4, featuring a groundbreaking 2 million token context window and significantly improved multi-step reasoning capabilities. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on complex coding and scientific benchmarks, surpassing previous leaders on MMLU and HumanEval. Anthropic claims Claude 4 sets a new standard for safety-aligned frontier models.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves Human-Level Performance on Medical Licensing Exams
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2.5 has achieved near-perfect scores across the USMLE, MCAT, and several international medical licensing examinations. The multimodal model can interpret radiology scans, lab results, and clinical notes simultaneously to generate diagnostic recommendations. Researchers caution that regulatory approval is still required before clinical deployment.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Agent Framework for Autonomous Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced a new agentic framework built on GPT-5 that allows enterprises to deploy fully autonomous AI agents capable of managing multi-day, multi-system workflows without human intervention. The platform integrates with over 300 enterprise tools including Salesforce, SAP, and ServiceNow out of the box. Early adopters report up to 60% reduction in operational overhead for routine back-office processes.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine to Meta Over LLaMA Training Data
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Act Enforcement Authority has levied a €1.2 billion fine against Meta, citing violations related to undisclosed copyrighted training data used in the LLaMA 4 model series. This marks the first significant enforcement action under the landmark regulation, which came into full effect in early 2026. Meta has announced it will appeal the ruling, calling the standards 'ambiguous and retroactively applied.'

articles.title: Microsoft Unveils RAG 2.0 Architecture Integrated Natively into Azure AI Search
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced a next-generation Retrieval-Augmented Generation architecture it calls RAG 2.0, now natively embedded within Azure AI Search services. The new system features dynamic knowledge graph integration, real-time re-ranking, and automated chunking strategies that reduce hallucination rates by an reported 40% compared to standard RAG pipelines. The update is rolling out to Azure enterprise customers through June.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI-Driven Misinformation Ahead of 2026 Midterms
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute released its annual AI Index report with a special section highlighting a dramatic surge in AI-generated political misinformation in the first half of 2026. Researchers documented a 340% increase in synthetic media incidents compared to the same period in 2024. The report urges Congress to fast-track platform accountability legislation before the November elections.

articles.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 3 as Open-Weight Model, Shaking Up the Open-Source Landscape
articles.summary: French AI startup Mistral AI has open-sourced its most powerful model to date, Mistral Large 3, under the Apache 2.0 license. The 72-billion parameter model reportedly matches GPT-4o on several key benchmarks while running efficiently on a single high-end consumer GPU. The release has energized the open-source AI community and intensified debate about the safety implications of releasing frontier-class weights publicly.

articles.title: Apple WWDC 2026: Apple Intelligence Gains On-Device Multimodal Reasoning with 'Siri Vision'
articles.summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple announced a major expansion of its Apple Intelligence platform, introducing 'Siri Vision,' a fully on-device multimodal reasoning engine for iPhone 17 and M4 Mac lineups. The feature allows Siri to understand and respond to live camera feeds, screen content, and documents simultaneously without sending data to the cloud. Apple emphasized privacy-preserving architecture as a key differentiator from cloud-dependent competitors.
